note: PASS 2 REJECTED, AND IT HAD INVERTED THE UNIT. Opened husks were parted and splayed without getting thinner: 16px across a 15.25px pitch, so every opened husk touched its neighbours and the wall BEHIND the front came back darker than the wall in front of it. The scene's argument ran backwards. Compounding it, the age backing band was capped at L(2) over the oldest third — exactly the end that opens first — so the ageing ramp was cancelling the emptying. The contact sheet at 10px sampling could not show either; the full-res frame showed both immediately.
